
                    ╔══════════════════════════════════════╗
                    ║  PCBoard 15.4 Revival — Installation  ║
                    ╚══════════════════════════════════════╝


    NEW INSTALLATION
    ════════════════

    1. Create a directory for PCBoard:
           MD C:\PCB
           CD C:\PCB

    2. From Disk 1, run:
           A:\INSTALL

       Or if installing from a directory:
           \DISK1\INSTALL

    3. The installer will:
       - Create the directory structure
       - Extract programs from Disk 2
       - Install documentation from Disk 3
       - Optionally install Internet Services from Disk 4

    4. After installation, run PCBSETUP to configure your board:
           PCBSETUP

       Key settings to configure first:
       - System name and sysop name
       - Number of nodes
       - Modem/COM port settings (or skip if using pcbis)
       - File area paths (DLPATH.LST)
       - Conference names and access levels

    5. Run LOCAL to test your board in local mode:
           LOCAL

    6. To accept callers:
       - Via modem: Run PCBOARDM with your FOSSIL driver loaded
       - Via internet: See "INTERNET SETUP" below


    INTERNET SETUP (pcbis.exe)
    ══════════════════════════

    pcbis.exe handles all internet protocols. Install from Disk 4:

    1. Copy files from Disk 4 to your PCBoard directory:
           COPY A:\PCBIS.EXE C:\PCB\
           COPY A:\PCBIS.CFG C:\PCB\
           COPY A:\INDEX.HTM C:\PCB\

    2. Edit PCBIS.CFG with a text editor:

       [telnet]
       port = 2323              Your telnet port
       max_nodes = 4            How many simultaneous callers
       node_start = 1           First PCBoard node number for telnet

       [binkp]
       enabled = yes             Enable if you want FidoNet
       address = 1:123/456.0    Your FidoNet address
       inbound = C:\PCB\INBOUND  Where BinkP drops received files

       [ftp]
       enabled = yes
       port = 21

       [http]
       enabled = yes
       port = 8080

       [smtp]
       enabled = yes
       relay = smtp.your-isp.com
       from = sysop@yourbbs.com

    3. Run pcbis:
           PCBIS

       The WFC (Waiting For Caller) screen will appear showing
       all active protocols and their status.

    4. Test: from another machine, telnet to your IP on port 2323.
       You should see the PCBoard login prompt.

    5. For web access: open http://your-ip:8080 in a browser.


    DIRECTORY STRUCTURE
    ═══════════════════

    After installation, your PCBoard directory looks like:

    C:\PCB\
    ├── PCBOARDM.EXE      Main BBS engine
    ├── PCBOARD.EXE       Non-386 version
    ├── LOCAL.EXE          Local login
    ├── PCBSETUP.EXE       Configuration
    ├── PCBSM.EXE          System manager
    ├── PPLC.EXE           PPL compiler
    ├── PCBIS.EXE          Internet services (optional)
    ├── PCBIS.CFG          Internet config (optional)
    ├── PCBOARD.DAT        System configuration
    ├── PCBTEXT             Prompts and text
    ├── USERS              User database
    ├── CNAMES.@@@         Conference names
    ├── DLPATH.LST         File area paths
    ├── GEN\               General files
    ├── PPE\               PPL scripts
    ├── HELP\              Help files
    └── MSGS\              Message bases
